title: Oil Filter Wrench 3-Jaw – Adjustable
descriptionHtml:
Get the filter off – without a fight

A stuck oil filter is a classic problem at oil changes. With the wrong tool you tear up your hands and still can't get it off.

Adjustable gripping force

The adjustable 3-jaw wrench grips the filter firmly from several directions. You get even tight-stuck filters off with a simple grip.

Features

  • Three jaws that grip firmly
  • Adjustable for different filter diameters
  • Gets even tight-stuck filters off
  • Fits most cars and engines
  • Durable material for a long service life

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
